column1: # Store-screenshot provenance. Read by the publish gate (zero-check.sh --public-tree).
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: a PNG carries no evidence of which build produced it, so the
# only way a gate can refuse a debug-captured store image is if provenance is written
# down and checksummed. See docs/screenshot-capture-playbook.md.
# FORMAT (tab-separated):  filename <TAB> sha256 <TAB> buildType <TAB> commit
# buildType values and what the gate does with each:
#   release            captured from a release build  -> pass, silently
#   unverified-legacy  provenance never established    -> pass, but named loudly
#   debug              captured from a debug build     -> FAIL
# There is no buildType for artwork with no build behind it — a former `designed` value was
# removed because nothing ever checked the evidence it claimed to require. See
# ../PROVENANCE.tsv (icon.png) and docs/screenshot-capture-playbook.md.
# A missing entry, a missing file, a DUPLICATE entry, or a checksum that does not match -> FAIL.
# EVERY regular file in this directory needs an entry — extensions are not enumerated, so an
# unexpected one fails closed rather than passing silently.
# buildType is HUMAN-ATTESTED and is never inferred. The gate catches drift after the
# first entry, not the truthfulness of the first entry itself.
# The COMMIT column IS machine-checked, as of M-99: `zero-check.sh` in PRIVATE mode
# asserts the commit resolves and that this file's content AT that commit equals column 2.
# Private, not public: these are private-repo commits and the public repo's squashed
# history does not contain them. Record the CONTENT commit that produced the capture --
# not the merge commit that later carried it, which is what row 05 held before M-99 and
# which pointed at a tree holding a DIFFERENT image. The commit must be a full 40-char
# lowercase SHA and an ancestor of HEAD (not of `main` — a re-shoot and its manifest
# update land in the SAME pull request, where the new commit is not yet on main).
# ⚠️ THE COMMIT COLUMN REFERS TO THE PRIVATE DEVELOPMENT REPOSITORY, and these SHAs are
# NOT resolvable in this public tree — its history is a squashed seed plus follow-ups.
# The column is verified there, on every pull request, by the private gate; it is not a
# claim a reader of this repo can check, and it is recorded here for traceability, not
# as public evidence. Stated explicitly because an unverifiable field that LOOKS
# checkable is the same decoration this manifest removed the `designed` buildType for.
